info.title: MB WAY - REST
info.description:
Welcome to the Rest MB WAY API documentation. This API allows you to initiate MB WAY payment requests with ease. To integrate with this API, you will need an 'MBWAY KEY' provided by ifthenpay, assigned to your merchant account. If you do not have this 'MBWAY KEY', please contact ifthenpay.
Before implementation, please verify if an existing integration is already available for your platform, whether developed by Ifthenpay, the platform provider, or a third party. You can check the list of available plugins and their corresponding e-commerce platforms [here](https://helpdesk.ifthenpay.com/pt-PT/support/solutions/articles/79000086132-plugins-para-plataformas-de-ecommerce).
ifthenpay offers free technical support to all customers through the following channels: - Email: [suporte@ifthenpay.com](suporte@ifthenpay.com) - Phone: 808 222 777 | +351 256 245 560 - Helpdesk: [submit a ticket](https://helpdesk.ifthenpay.com) - Site: [www.ifthenpay.com](https://ifthenpay.com)
